title: everybody-should-be-talking-to-the-inference-domain-via-the-bus
intention: every device should reach inference_domain through the bus, not by importing it directly
why: device_isolation ruling says only db_domain is exempt from cross-device import ban. librarian (and others) currently import inference_domain directly for embeddings. The bus is the sole path for inter-device comms — direct imports violate both the ruling and the bus design.
traces_to: Law 6 (everything has exactly one owner), no-cross-device-imports ruling, provider-doesn't-know-consumers principle

falsifier.proves_green: grep -r from.cairn.devices.inference_domain across all devices other than inference_domain itself returns zero hits; every inference call routes through bus.request() or bus.post()
falsifier.proves_red: any device other than inference_domain still imports from cairn.devices.inference_domain directly after the fix

constraints: db_domain is the sole cross-device import exemption — inference_domain gets no exemption
bus.request() is the inter-device call path; bus.post() for fire-and-forget
how: each device that imports inference_domain directly gets refactored to use bus verbs instead. inference_domain exposes its capabilities as bus verbs (embed, infer, etc.).

decisions.text: D-SURVEY. Measured 2026-09-18 by AST walk over cairn/**/*.py (proofs, probes, proofs_disabled skipped — the same population device_isolation_holds reads): exactly ONE importer outside cairn/devices/inference_domain — cairn/tools/bus_client/bus_client.py's inference_seam(), which did 'from cairn.devices.inference_domain.domain import InferenceDomainDevice' and handed back domain.resolve to a subprocess with no bus (the aider_shim venv driver). aider_shim's interceptor took that seam as its no-bus fallback. Nothing else in the tree reaches the owner by import.

D-REACH-BUS. bus_client.inference_seam() is REMOVED. In its place bus_client.inference_bus() returns cairn.tools.bus_client.reach('inference_domain') — a real in-process bus with a ground loop and inference_domain's shim pulsed once (no beat) — and bus_client.models_stack() is a bus.request(sender='bus_client', to='inference_domain', verb='get', body={'what':'models'})['body']['data'] on it. Measured cost of reach: ~3s, paid once per process. Every consumer that had no bus now has one; nobody imports the owner.
decisions.step: how a surface with no bus reaches inference_domain

decisions.text: D-INTERCEPTOR. cairn/devices/aider_shim/interceptor.py build(*, resolver, fence, log, models_stack, resolve, bus, ticket): a lazy _bus() holds the injected bus if one was given, else builds inference_bus() once on first need. _do_resolve: an injected resolve is called as resolve(request, resolver=resolver) — unchanged, and it never fills a gap from the host; with no injected resolve the request rides _bus().request(sender='aider_shim', to='inference_domain', verb='resolve', why='aider completion', body=request) and the reply body is the answer. _stack(models_stack, bus_of=None): an injected stack is returned as is; otherwise the stack is a get/what=models on bus_of() (default inference_bus). The 'models_stack as _seam' fallback is gone. The venv driver.py (holder.hold(resolve=None, resolver=None)) is untouched — it is exactly the no-bus path that now rides the reach bus.

D-PROOF. The falsifier is unnumbered, so ONE composite tooth (PROVES = {'87a7f1c7ae21': {'all': 'test_every_inference_call_rides_the_bus'}}) at cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/proofs/test_inference_rides_the_bus.py, beside the owning intention (the bus machine). The composite calls four sub-teeth in order: (1) AST walk over every cairn/**/*.py outside cairn/devices/inference_domain (proofs/probes/proofs_disabled dirs skipped) finds ZERO imports of cairn.devices.inference_domain — asserts >100 modules walked and that bus_client.py and interceptor.py are in the walk, so an emptied walk cannot pass; (2) a surface built with no bus and no resolve, with cairn.tools.bus_client.inference_bus monkeypatched to a recording bus, answers completion() with verbs ['get','resolve'] from sender aider_shim, exactly one bus built, and the choice text is the bus's answer; (3) bus_client.models_stack() is a get on the bus (reach monkeypatched to a recording bus) and bus_client has no attribute inference_seam; (4) the real inference_bus() answers get/models non-empty in-process. The recording bus's provenance provider is read from Fence().providers (the live fence is ['hex']; a hard-coded 'ollama' raised AskWidened on the first run). Green twice (5 passed, ~7.6s); hand-hollowing interceptor.py reds sub-teeth 2 and 4; the aider_shim proofs (test_no_direct_reach, test_driver) stay green.

D-LIVE. Fired once for real 2026-09-18: a no-bus aider completion (the venv driver path) built the reach bus and got a LIVE _Response from the host through inference_domain's resolve verb, rc=0 (scratchpad live87a7.log). The build is committed as one commit in cairn naming this ticket; the hook resealed aider_shim's and bus_client's closures.

D-VERBS. LANDED (this ticket, commit after 973daf6f in cairn): cairn/devices/inference_domain/device.py declared_verbs() returns {**super().declared_verbs(), 'resolve': self._handle_resolve, 'embed': self._handle_embed, 'infer': self._handle_infer}; a module-level _with_kind(envelope, kind) copies the envelope with body['kind'] fixed; _handle_embed = _handle_resolve over kind 'embed', _handle_infer = _handle_resolve over kind 'generate' (the domain's two request kinds — 'infer' is the chart's name for a completion). The verb overrides a caller's own kind key. Nothing else in the tree adds verbs: e194f4b4cb3e adds nothing this ticket needs. The verbs inference_domain exposes are therefore: show, get (views yield and models), resolve, embed, infer.
decisions.step: unlisted: Add embed/infer verbs to inference_domain.device

decisions.text: D-REACH-CONTRACT. cairn.tools.bus_client.reach(*devices) is landed code (cairn/tools/bus_client/bus_client.py, proven by test_a_client_reaches_and_never_beats.py): it builds a BusDevice, a GroundLoopDevice, discovers each named device's shim from cairn/devices/<name>/shim.py, pulses each once (no beat), and returns the bus. bus.request(sender=<str>, to=<device id>, verb=<str>, why=<str>, body=<dict>) fires the poke chain synchronously and returns the reply ENVELOPE, a dict whose 'body' is the handler's return value — for get the body is {'device','view','cached','timestamp','data'} so the stack is reply['body']['data']; for resolve/embed/infer the body is domain.resolve's result {'answer','hit','canonical','cost','provenance','ticket'} (or the refusal shape {'outcome':'refused',...}). The verbs inference_domain must expose before D2 runs are get and resolve; both predate this ticket.
decisions.step: D2 reach() and the request contract

decisions.text: D-D3-AFTER-D2. D3 (the interceptor) rides D2's inference_bus() and the get/resolve verbs; both are in HEAD (18e1923d). D3's code is also in HEAD in the same commit. There is no ordering to enforce at build time because there is no build left — only verification.

D-TWO-PROOFS. Both exist and both are required: (A) cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/proofs/test_inference_rides_the_bus.py (D4) carries PROVES for this ticket's falsifier — the sole-path composite tooth over get/resolve — and is what proven_by names at PROVEME; (B) cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_bus_infer.py is the chart's second criterion (validate-20260906T111940-63fc41318d0d): a device asks infer then embed over the bus with a stub resolver (unittest.mock.patch on cairn.devices.inference_domain.host.ollama_resolver), no host dialed — five teeth: declaration beside resolve, infer answers a completion, embed answers a vector, the verb fixes the kind over a contrary body, the stub saw every request. (B) is not in PROVES: it proves the chart's criterion, the falsifier is proven by (A). The decompose chart's path is (B); the ticket's falsifier tooth is (A). No reconciliation is owed — the chart asked for (B) and it exists.
